data.body: Parent 1c1b fresh plan review found its compatibility AC was only partially delegated: no child explicitly owned a per-caller proof that every existing push caller remains best-effort. Plan updated to add an executable parametrized caller-contract matrix over event append, batch append, NDJSON import, transition close, both delete paths, both compact paths, and claim. Each site must omit strict (or reach core with strict=False), preserve its legacy return/disposition, and inherit only the shared five-cycle plus exactly-one-final-push correction. This intentionally stales the prior attestation; re-review follows before claim.
